property_summary: Across any sequence of successful 10-ether fallback calls, c.pastBlockTime() must strictly increase between consecutive successful calls (it always stores the strictly larger block.timestamp); the mutant stores block.number instead, so for some warp/roll schedule the second stored value is not larger.
change_summary: Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the stored value is a block number rather than a timestamp.
